summary_zh: 开源、可自托管的 AI 安全运营中心：接入安全遥测，规范化后用可执行检测规则发现并关联威胁，由 AI 代理调查并记录每一步推理，提出需人工批准的动作；附带 MCP 服务器，支持 MITRE ATT&CK 调查与可回放决策账本。
audience_zh: 适合需要自建安全运营与告警调查流程的 SOC 团队、安全工程师，以及希望审计 AI 代理调查过程、部署时无需托管 API 密钥并偏好开源 MIT 方案的组织。

evidence.quote: Open-source AI Security Operations Center: alert fusion, LLM-agent triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation, and a replayable decision ledger for every agent step. Self-hostable, runs with no API keys, MIT licensed. Ships an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Continue.

**An open-source, self-hostable AI Security Operations Center.** It ingests your security telemetry, detects and correlates threats, investigates them with AI agents whose reasoning is fully auditable, and proposes responses a human approves.
